SEARCH
Package com.example.inelasticsearch.coordinator

Class ShardCopySelector

java.lang.Object
com.example.inelasticsearch.coordinator.ShardCopySelector
final class ShardCopySelector extends Object
Picks which copy of a shard to query next, round-robin across its primary and replicas so read traffic spreads across all live copies instead of always hitting the primary. Used only by CoordinatorServiceImpl.search(com.example.inelasticsearch.rpc.SearchRequest, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<com.example.inelasticsearch.rpc.SearchResponse>) — write routing always targets the primary directly via ClusterTopology.nodeFor(int) and never goes through this class.

Every shard gets its own independent AtomicInteger counter, so calling nextCandidates(int) for one shard doesn't affect another's rotation. State is built once from the topology at construction and only the counters mutate afterward, so a single instance is shared for the coordinator's whole lifetime (see CoordinatorServiceImpl's selector field) and is safe under concurrent search requests.

    • nextCandidates

      List<NodeAddress> nextCandidates(int shardId)
      The copies of shardId, rotated to start at the next round-robin position. The caller should try them in order: the first entry is this call's pick, the rest are fallback candidates if it turns out to be unreachable.
